asksDocIntro: For your firm, not for the client. For each question the tool drafted an answer to, this lists what the proposal itself supplies and what to confirm with your client before you send the response. Nothing here is in the downloaded response.
asksDocSection22:
2.2 How would you connect our Customer Journey Analytics data to AI assistant traffic, and what do you need from us?

Part of this proposal

  • The paid Brand Visibility offering, not the free trial (CJA's page requires it for the source)

Ask your client for

  • CDN access logs forwarded to and received by Brand Visibility for each site, and Adobe's confirmation that the site is available in the source
    Will confirm with the client
  • An Experience Platform user who sets up the Adobe Brand Visibility source dataflow in the sandbox used by the CJA connection; each site can be allocated to one dataflow only
    Client says: An AEP user is in place.
  • A CJA administrator who adds the Brand Visibility dataset to a connection on that sandbox and its fields to a data view; Adobe's managed connector stops at the Experience Platform dataset
    Will confirm with the client
  • A full URL field in the web event dataset that matches Brand Visibility's CDN URL, for the page join
    Will confirm with the client
  • A CJA derived field that groups AI referring domains, for referral analysis inside CJA (CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate; derived fields are not in CJA Foundation)
    Will confirm with the client
